capabilities: Format selected text into HTML kbd tags with a user-assigned shortcut
Recognize modifier, function, command, numpad, and arrow key names case-insensitively
Convert mouse button names like lmb, rmb, and wheel into formatted labels
Customize kbd text and background colors with light and dark themes
extras: README includes a manual installation path via GitHub releases and links to a Ko-fi page for donations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly and consistently mark up key names like ctrl shift a as semantic, visually distinct <kbd> elements.
summary: Plugin that converts selected text naming keyboard keys and mouse buttons into styled HTML <kbd> elements via a configurable shortcut.
